title: The Deflection
concept: A deflection forces an enemy piece to leave the square or line it was guarding. Once it is gone, the thing it protected falls.
tip: Find the piece doing an important defending job, then make a threat it must answer somewhere else.

feedback.correct: Yes! You pulled the defender away — that is a deflection. Now the square it guarded is yours.
feedback.hint: Which enemy piece is guarding something important? Give it a job it cannot refuse.
feedback.reveal: Force the defender to move. Once it can no longer guard, the piece or square behind it collapses.
